# Workflowssvg image

Relevant source files

- [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md)
- [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml)

## Purpose and Scopesvg image

This section demonstrates common usage patterns and workflows for different use cases of the Contexter system. It provides an overview of how the 12 command-line tools can be chained together to accomplish specific tasks.

For detailed step-by-step instructions on each workflow, see the child pages:

- Basic packaging and reconstruction: [Basic Packaging Workflow](/ray0404/Contexter/4.1-basic-packaging-workflow)
- Working with AI-generated code: [AI Integration Workflow](/ray0404/Contexter/4.2-ai-integration-workflow)
- Managing incremental changes: [Version Control with Patches](/ray0404/Contexter/4.3-version-control-with-patches)
- Converting between formats: [Format Conversion Workflow](/ray0404/Contexter/4.4-format-conversion-workflow)

For detailed documentation of individual commands, see [Command Reference](/ray0404/Contexter/5-command-reference).

## Workflow Categoriessvg image

Contexter supports four primary workflow patterns, each addressing a distinct use case:

| Workflow Category | Primary Commands | Use Case |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Packaging** | `buildcontext`, `buildcontexthtml`, `reconstructor`, `reconstructorhtml` | Convert projects to portable single-file format and back |
| **AI Integration** | `sanitizecontext`, `reconstructor` | Transform AI-generated code into working projects |
| **Version Control** | `updatecontext`, `smartupdate`, `updater`, `updatecontexthtml`, `updaterhtml` | Generate and apply patches for incremental updates |
| **Format Conversion** | `md2html`, `html2md` | Convert context files between Markdown and HTML |

Each workflow represents a complete operation cycle, from initial input to final output. Workflows can be combined; for example, an AI-generated context file can be sanitized, then converted to HTML, then reconstructed.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md22-35](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L22-L35)

## Command Execution Flowsvg image

### Workflow 1: Basic Packaging and Reconstructionsvg image

This is the foundational workflow for converting directories to context files and back.

**Diagram: Packaging and Reconstruction Command Flow**

The packaging commands (`buildcontext`, `buildcontexthtml`) accept a directory path and output a single context file. The reconstruction commands (`reconstructor`, `reconstructorhtml`) perform the inverse operation, reading a context file and writing a directory structure.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md24-25](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L24-L25) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md30-31](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L30-L31)

### Workflow 2: AI Integration Pipelinesvg image

This workflow addresses the common problem of AI models generating code without proper formatting.

**Diagram: AI-to-Project Conversion Pipeline**

The `sanitizecontext` command acts as a preprocessor, fixing missing code fences and formatting issues before the `reconstructor` command parses the file. This eliminates manual editing steps.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md9-18](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L9-L18) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md26](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L26-L26)

### Workflow 3: Patch Generation and Applicationsvg image

This workflow manages versioned context files through differential patches.

**Diagram: Update and Patch Management Workflows**

Two update strategies are available:

- **Standard (`updatecontext`)**: Compares two context files, generates unified diff patch
- **Smart (`smartupdate`)**: Uses rsync-based delta encoding for high efficiency (recommended)

Both generate `.patch.md` or `.patch.html` files that can be applied using `updater` or `updaterhtml`.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md27-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L27-L29) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md32-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L32-L33)

### Workflow 4: Format Conversion Bridgesvg image

This workflow enables migration and interoperability between Markdown and HTML formats.

**Diagram: Bidirectional Format Conversion**

The `md2html` and `html2md` commands perform lossless conversions between formats, allowing users to:

- Build in Markdown, distribute in HTML
- Accept either format as input
- Normalize mixed-format workflows

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md34-35](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L34-L35)

## Workflow Execution Patternssvg image

### Sequential Command Chainingsvg image

Workflows are implemented by piping command outputs through the filesystem:

Each command is a self-contained operation that reads files and writes files. The filesystem acts as the data bus between commands.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md15-18](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L15-L18)

### Command Selection Matrixsvg image

The following table helps users select the appropriate commands for their workflow:

| Goal | Input Format | Output Format | Commands Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Package project (Markdown) | Directory | `.md` | `buildcontext` |
| Package project (HTML) | Directory | `.html` | `buildcontexthtml` |
| Unpack project (Markdown) | `.md` | Directory | `reconstructor` |
| Unpack project (HTML) | `.html` | Directory | `reconstructorhtml` |
| Fix AI output | `.md` (malformed) | `.md` (valid) | `sanitizecontext` |
| Create patch (efficient) | 2 directories | `.patch.md` | `smartupdate` |
| Create patch (standard) | 2 `.md` files | `.patch.md` | `updatecontext` |
| Create patch (HTML) | 2 `.html` files | `.patch.md/.html` | `updatecontexthtml` |
| Apply patch (Markdown) | `.md` + `.patch.md` | `.md` | `updater` |
| Apply patch (HTML) | `.html` + `.patch.md/.html` | `.html` | `updaterhtml` |
| Convert MD to HTML | `.md` | `.html` | `md2html` |
| Convert HTML to MD | `.html` | `.md` | `html2md` |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md22-35](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L22-L35)

## Command-Module Mappingsvg image

Each command maps directly to an implementation module in the codebase:

**Diagram: Command-to-Module Mapping**

This 1:1 mapping means workflows can be understood by examining the corresponding Python modules. Each module in `contexter/` implements the logic for one command.

For detailed architecture information, see [Module Organization](/ray0404/Contexter/6.2-module-organization).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md22-35](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L22-L35)

## Workflow Compositionsvg image

Advanced users can compose workflows by combining multiple commands:

**Diagram: Multi-Stage Workflow Composition Example**

This example demonstrates:

1. Packaging a project as Markdown
2. Converting to HTML for distribution
3. Converting back to Markdown
4. Sanitizing (optional processing step)
5. Reconstructing to directory

Each step is independent and reversible, allowing flexible workflow design.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md22-35](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L22-L35)

## Workflow Entry Pointssvg image

Users typically enter the Contexter system through one of three scenarios:

| Entry Point | Starting Artifact | First Command | Typical Goal |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **New Project Creation** | Existing directory | `buildcontext` or `buildcontexthtml` | Create portable backup or share with AI |
| **AI-Generated Code** | Text file from AI chat | `sanitizecontext` | Convert AI output to working project |
| **Received Context File** | `.md` or `.html` file | `reconstructor` or `reconstructorhtml` | Extract project to local filesystem |

Once in the system, users can transition between workflows as needed. For example, after reconstructing a project, they might package it again with modifications and generate a patch against the original.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md9-18](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L9-L18) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md22-35](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L22-L35)
